run_harvest_level: run the Harvest level interactive player with WASD movement and Q/E turning
run_harvest_custom_screen: run the Harvest level with custom screen width, height, and frames per second settings
run_harvest_verbose: run the Harvest level with verbose output enabled for debugging
run_harvest_display_text: run the Harvest level with a custom debug text message displayed on screen
run_harvest_rgb_observation: run the Harvest level rendering RGB observations via PyGame
